summaryZh: MOSAIC Laboratory 研究大规模传感数据系统和多模态AI/机器学习，用于健康与行为建模，重点利用异构传感模态和平台构建可扩展、节能的移动感测系统。
researchQuestions: 如何结合异构传感器和多模态AI进行健康与行为建模？
如何使移动传感数据系统兼顾规模和能耗？
topics: 节能大规模传感数据系统
methods: 环境和生理信号的数据建模

evidence.quote: The Mobile Sensing and Ubiquitous Computing Laboratory at the University of California San Diego conducts research on large-scale sensor data systems and multimodal AI/ML for health and behavior modeling.
Our focus is on building scalable, energy-efficient sensor data systems through the use of heterogeneous sensor modalities and platforms for solving real-world problems.
translating environmental and physiological signals into meaningful data
